name: Under Watch
description: Ask Irina Kovalenko about Milena's mother's belongings, then search the factory rooftop for her journal. A sun amulet among her belongings can be kept with the journal.
offerText: Could you ask Kovalenko about Mother's belongings?

stages.description: Ask Irina Kovalenko where the factory kept Milena's mother's belongings.
Find another way onto the main factory roof and search its toolbox for Milena's mother's journal. Select it in inventory and press Enter to read.
